title: Baar Baar Dekho
desc: Mathematics professor Jai gets cold feet about marrying his girlfriend Diya. After the marriage is cancelled, he goes on a journey through time, seeing what it would be like if he married Diya.

title: Dhadak
desc: A world of uncertainties awaits Madhu and Parthavi as their love transcends class divides and blossoms despite the fierce disapproval of their families.

title: Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
desc: Sanjana falls in love with Prem Kishen after mistaking him for his boss, Prem Kumar, whom she is actually supposed to marry. But, the relationship is threatened when Prem Kishen reveals the truth.

title: Family - Ek Deal
desc: A father urges his son to take revenge from the person who cheated him. Later, the son comes up with a plan to fulfil his father's wishes.

title: Antim: The Final Truth
desc: Rahul runs away from his poverty-stricken village life to become a gangster in the city. There, he locks horns with an upstanding policeman who tries to set him on the right path.
